title: Tokenizers and HuggingFace ONNX Model Pipeline (UE5)
author: NoahPersaud
selftext:
I created a [tokenizers plugin](https://github.com/NextGen-GameDev/Tokenizers-UE) and an [HuggingFace ONNX model pipeline plugin](https://github.com/NextGen-GameDev/ModelPipelines-UE) for UE5. 

  
The tokenizers repo is fairly complete for Windows, but does not currently support other platforms.

The pipelines repo only supports text embeddings, text classification, image classification and object detection for now. I plan to add a lot more in the future.

  
I don't know if I used the right flair. This is self-promotion, but the plugins are open source. Claude was used to build both, but I started Tokenizers myself years ago.

Contributions are welcome.
